# Email notifications for repository push events have been retired

## What Changed

As of October 15, 2026, email notifications for repository push events have been retired and are no longer sent. We shut down this feature to help prevent spam and abuse.…

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This can create a customer delivery blocker or migration requirement.

## Customer Impact
